"This is it. Today, victory shall be 
mine."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to today, I've run countless 
simulations with you.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Analyzing the race results, discussing 
them back and forth, and actually testing 
them with my own legs—I've found the best 
possible move.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
There shouldn't be any flaws in our 
strategy.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Let us go, Trainer. The rematch begins 
now!
